caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden sideboard, characterized by a rectangular top surface with gently curved front edges. The sideboard is primarily brown, rendered with varying shades to suggest wood grain and texture. The front of the sideboard features three drawers in the center, each with a round brass or gold-colored handle, with the lower central drawer slightly arched at the bottom. On either side of the drawers, there are two large cabinet doors, each also having a circular design and a centrally placed round brass or gold-colored handle. The sideboard stands on four straight, tapered legs, each decorated with a subtle vertical inlay suggesting a lighter wood tone. The entire image is set against a plain, light beige or off-white background, with no additional objects or decorations present.
title: Sideboard
